tape: All 14 screens ran at defaults; the CSP screen returned 20 setups. Nothing sells tonight: the one clean chart and its runner-up both look to have a quarterly report inside the expiry.
One uptrend in 20 (SAIL). 13 grade downtrend, 6 mixed. 19 of 20 trade under their 200 SMA; FRVO has no 200-day history yet.
14 of 20 are down on the week. MARA, ASST and BKSY have strikes already under their 60-day lows.
IV rank (CBOE, 52-week) came through on all 20: 10 rich, 9 mid, 1 cheap. Quotes: 12 firm, 8 wide. No earnings date came through for any of the 20.
Five correlation clusters: WULF+MARA+RIOT, PLAB+ALGM+PENG+VIAV, LUNR+MRAM+NVTS+OUST, SMCI+CRWV, BMNR+ASST.
Gamma scan flipped: 18 of 25 names in positive gamma, 7 negative (last night was 17 negative).
